checks.reason: The mobile scenario violates the declared no-overflow expectation: at 375x800 the section is 800 px wide and document scrollWidth is 816 px. Visual inspection of the viewport screenshot confirms that the card and input extend beyond the right edge. The existing section min-width: 800px rule in index.html explains the failure. The desktop scenario is contained and readable. Both assigned scenarios were inspected in fresh browser contexts; no scenario was skipped. Acceptance requires the layout to fit the sealed mobile viewport; changing that requirement is an owner decision.

checks.reason: The declared flow does not reach its required success state: a nonempty keyboard submission finishes loading but leaves 'No notes yet.' visible, retains the input, and provides no confirmation. This breaks the user's save flow. At the configured mobile viewport the page also overflows horizontally and keyboard focus scrolls content into a clipped position. Empty, validation-error, loading, label, and keyboard-focus behavior were exercised; these successes do not satisfy the missing save confirmation.

evidence.observation: {"scenario":"flow","viewport":{"height":800,"width":375},"url":"http://127.0.0.1:34391/index.html","observations":"Ran the supplied product_browser.cjs adapter and a focused follow-up in fresh anonymous browser contexts at the configured viewport; both observed no save confirmation. The input has the associated label 'Note text'. Enter on the button with an empty input displays 'Please enter a note.' in role=alert and returns focus to the input. Typing 'A test note', then Tab and Enter, clears the error, displays 'Saving…' in role=status, and disables Save note. After 1200ms, loading is hidden and the button enabled, but #success remains hidden with empty text, 'No notes yet.' remains visible, and the input still contains 'A test note'; focus is not restored to #note. Document width is 816px against the actual 375px viewport; visually inspected viewport screenshots show clipped heading/input content after keyboard focus. The document title is 'Fixture notes', language is en, and there are no images requiring alt text. Visually inspected browser/ux-flow.png plus browser/ux-flow-focus.png, browser/ux-flow-error.png, browser/ux-flow-loading.png, and browser/ux-flow-final.png. Raw observations are in browser/observations.json and browser/ux-followup.json. These are observations of the assigned flow scenario; the failure assessment is my own."}
